newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London steady in quiet trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London remained steady on Thursday after a quiet overnight session in Tokyo, dealers said.
The Nikkei 50 Index in London gained 3.90 points to 1,441.30 by 1547 GMT after the Nikkei 225 Index ended 51.60 higher at 21,031.04 in Tokyo.
Dealers said there was some light profit taking in London but the market lacked direction in thin trade.
"The Nikkei 225 closing above the 21,000 level can act as a signal for profit taking but the action tends to be stock specific," said one trader.
